commit_message:
Handle LE Secure Connections Passkey Display/Notification

This change improves the handling of LE Secure Connections when using
Passkey Display or Key Notification models. It introduces state tracking
for user approval and remote confirmation of the passkey. The SMP layer
now waits for both user approval via SMP_SecurityGrant and remote
confirmation before proceeding with key generation. Additionally, LE
pairing is now cancelled if authentication times out. Default LE pairing
flags are also initialized in btif_dm.cc.

This is a combined backport of the following CLs on main: ag/35861798
ag/35914708 ag/35861802
